description:
Global Metadata: Epic hybrid orchestral trailer music for a blockbuster science-fiction movie trailer about a space battle to defend Earth. 120 BPM, C minor. Structure and dynamics are essential, with huge dynamic range: the track starts in near silence, builds tension, explodes into a massive drop, keeps escalating with ever bigger impacts, reaches an enormous heroic climax, then stops dead into complete silence before one final gigantic boom. Production profile: modern Hollywood trailer sound design hybrid, wide stereo, punchy sub-bass impacts, very hard transient hits, loud polished master.

Vocal Details: Instrumental, no lyrics. A wordless epic choir only in the climax.

Arrangement: [Intro] almost silent, a deep low sub drone and distant metallic shimmer, one lonely low piano note. [Build] a ticking synth pulse on every beat, staccato low strings ostinato, deep brass braams every four bars, each braam bigger, reverse swells, a rising snare roll and a riser into the drop. [Drop] a colossal impact hit, thunderous taiko ensemble and massive drums on every beat, distorted synth bass, brass stabs, metallic slams on the downbeats. [Escalation] relentless driving percussion, sixteenth note strings, hits on every two beats, risers, whooshes, getting faster and bigger. [Climax] full orchestra and choir, soaring French horn theme, crashing cymbals, huge taiko fills, a hit on every bar. [Break] abrupt hard stop, total silence for one second. [Outro] one enormous low sub boom with a long shimmering metallic tail fading out.
